Dropshipping suppliers are not perfect.
Their stock and return handling are often weak.
Plan to move to **private agents (your own agents) or your own warehouse** (a space where you store stock) once sales are high enough.

p.t: Choosing a fulfillment partner

For beginners, the recommended fulfillment apps are **CJ Dropshipping or Hyper Rescue**.
They are more reliable.
They offer **live agent support** (a real person you can chat with) for refunds, returns and damaged packages.
Automation-only apps such as AutoDS (apps that work only automatically) lack real after-sales support.
Choose a fulfillment app with **live agent support** rather than a pure automation app.
Refund, return and damaged-package cases are resolved through the supplier's agents inside the app.
CJ Dropshipping and Hyper Rescue both offer live agent support inside their apps for refunds, returns and damaged packages.

CJ Dropshipping can also provide **personal support** once a store reaches good order volumes.
Start with **one** fulfillment provider, such as HyperSQ.

Switch to CJ Dropshipping or Zendrop if service quality is poor.
The right provider depends on the product.

The right provider also depends on the support agent assigned to you.
Request quotes from **three or four** fulfillment companies before you choose one.

Quotes typically arrive within **1-2 business days**.
Compare prices and the assigned support contact, not just the price per item.

A supplier typically assigns an agent to the seller.
That agent can check orders, fulfillment problems and orders lost in transit.

Using a dedicated agent contact is a way to resolve supplier issues quickly.
If a supplier's website gives only one support contact, **post your question in the community chat**.

You can also ask a mentor directly for their experience.
Mentors often respond faster this way than through the supplier's support.

Choosing a supplier by product is a valid approach.

AliExpress: role and limits
p.s: Dropshipping platforms and agents (CJ, hyper rescue, zendrop, AliExpress)

p.t: Older advice from 2019 says AliExpress is **not recommended as a long-term model**.

The reasons: delivery takes too long, product quality varies, returns are hard to handle, **chargebacks** (a buyer reverses a card payment through the bank) are common, and prices cannot be controlled.

Such a model can make money in the short term.
But it is unstable for building a lasting store.
Older advice from 2021 says AliExpress brings slow shipping, inconsistent quality, mostly low-cost goods, difficult returns and no brand loyalty.

It does not build a lasting business.
Use AliExpress only as a **short-term supplier option**.
Move to better suppliers **as soon as possible**.

**Avoid AliExpress as a direct fulfillment source.**
Its shipping times are very long and its support is unreliable.
Use a dedicated fulfillment company that connects to your store instead.
Sourcing from AliExpress requires a lot of manual work and gives little customer support.
When a product is poor quality, AliExpress refunds are less reliable than those from dedicated dropshipping suppliers.
A cheap product sourced from AliExpress with slow shipping leads to angry customers and poor reviews.

If you want a lasting brand, **do not copy a competitor** who sells this way.
**Check shipping times** before you commit to a supplier.

Realistic AliExpress shipping was about **14 to 15 days** in one example, which was considered acceptable.
Delivery times of **4 to 6 weeks** are a serious problem.

Direct AliExpress orders could take up to **about two months**.
Shein can potentially be used as a fulfillment source for dropshipped orders.

This may work especially for audiences on Facebook who are less aware of Shein.
The speaker has not yet tested this. It needs to be verified before use.

Reselling without this step carries the risk of the account being **banned**.

CJ Dropshipping: listing a product in Shopify (procedure)
1. **Search** for the product on CJ Dropshipping, or search by keyword to find similar listings.
2. Open the listing and **select the variant** (color and style). The variant changes the product price.
3. Check the product price, the shipping cost and the total cost for the target country.
4. Compare shipping options. Pick the one with the best balance of low cost and reasonable delivery time (for example **7 to 15 days**).
5. Choose the **List** button, not Connect, for the product you want to add to the store.

6. Set the store name, product type, collection (a group of products), vendor (the supplier label) and a **target price (the selling price in the store). For example, set 39.99 USD**. The vendor can be, for example, 'cj'.

7. Click **List it now**.
8. Wait **1 to 2 minutes** for the product to appear in the Shopify store.
9. Edit product title, images, descriptions and prices in Shopify as needed.
On CJ Drop Shipping, the **Connect** option adds the product to the store with images, videos and descriptions that you can edit.
The **List** option is used when you add the product with a target price directly through the listing screen.
CJ Dropshipping has a very large catalog (its full list of products), so most products can be found and listed directly.

CJ Drop Shipping has a very large catalog. So most products found on AliExpress can also be found there.
Products can be connected to a Shopify store **within minutes**.
CJ Dropshipping has a trending products page with product categories. It is convenient for browsing dropshipping products.
Its delivery times can be slow unless you pay for faster options.

Pricing, negotiation and agent selection
p.s: Dropshipping platforms and agents (CJ, hyper rescue, zendrop, AliExpress)

p.t: Supplier pricing does not automatically decrease in quality.
If a supplier cannot lower price further, it will say so.
Volume commitments (promises to buy a set quantity), especially stock, give you **negotiation leverage** (power to bargain).
Negotiate in the live chat of the supplier with a human agent, ideally during Chinese working hours.
Automated replies rarely offer discounts, so **get a live agent first**.
Listed prices on platforms such as Hyper Rescue and CJ are often higher than what you can get through direct negotiation.
Do not accept the listed price without **asking a live agent for a discount**.
Platforms and agents such as CJ Dropshipping and Hyper Rescue often list higher prices to new dropshippers.

They do this because they prioritize long-term partners who bring steady volume.
Negotiate by live chat and expect lower prices than the listed price.
Listed prices are negotiable through live chat for CJ Dropshipping and Hyper Rescue.
Play agents against each other by sharing a competing agent's quote in chat and asking for a better offer.

Ask each agent for a quote that beats the others to get the **best price**.
Suppliers and agents do not mind when you send the same inquiry to several of them.
They compete for good long-term clients, so the goal is to be a **strong client** to whoever you choose.
Once a store reaches a consistent daily order count, suppliers may negotiate price and pre-order a week of inventory into their warehouse.
Request stock inventory for at least **one week** when reaching 10+ daily orders.
Immediately **stop shipping new items from China** to enable faster stock-based fulfillment if a customer cancels.

Order stock starting at **10+ orders per day** to save 0.5-1 dollar per item.
Ordering stock also reduces processing time to 12 hours (vs. 2-5 days normally).
A dedicated fulfillment agent or personal agent can prioritize your orders at CJ Dropshipping when the default processing times are not reliable.
Asking for better service with no sales history (procedure)
p.s: Dropshipping platforms and agents (CJ, hyper rescue, zendrop, AliExpress)

p.t: No sales history means you have not sold much yet.

1. State that you have sold before and that this is a new store you are testing with products.
2. Say that you want a **long-term partnership**.
3. Ask for better quotes and explain that you have experience.
4. Ask for a **personal agent** (one contact person just for you). The platforms provided one by Skype (a video and chat app).
5. Send **consistent sales**, because suppliers give better service to customers who bring steady business.
Hello [Name], I am an experienced dropshipper and have built multiple six-figure stores.
I am now starting a new project in the [niche] niche, and I am looking for a long-term partnership rather than a one-off order.
My current agent quotes [current price] for [product] at [volume] orders per month.

If you can match or beat that price and offer a good discount for [product] at [volume] orders per month, I would like to move forward with you. Please tell me what minimum volume you need to offer your best rates.
Use the 1688.com price when negotiating. 1688.com is a Chinese domestic wholesale platform (a marketplace inside China for bulk buying).

It shows the actual price suppliers pay.
The site is in Chinese, so translate it.
Then compare that price with your agent's quote to see the markup (extra amount added on top of the real price) being charged.

Personal agents usually require a minimum of about **5-10 orders per day**.
Move to a personal agent once your volume reaches that level.
Ecom Ops requires a minimum order quantity (MOQ, the smallest amount you must buy) of about **100 units** per item.
Other agents can work with volumes like about 5 orders per day or around 100 orders per month.

p.s: Dropshipping platforms and agents (CJ, hyper rescue, zendrop, AliExpress)

p.t: Hello, I'd like to dropship this item: [PRODUCT NAME]. Photo of the product attached: [Attach product photo].

Switching checklist (procedure)
p.s: Dropshipping platforms and agents (CJ, hyper rescue, zendrop, AliExpress)

p.t: 1. Before switching suppliers, **stop running ads** on the date the old supplier will stop receiving orders.
Orders placed after this date may stay unprocessed (not yet handled) and cause refund (money returned to the customer) and delivery problems.
2. **Check** that all paid orders on the old platform are marked as fulfilled (marked as shipped or handled) in Shopify (the software your online store runs on).
Unmarked orders can be paid for twice when the new supplier ships them.
3. For Day One specifically, **request a quotation** (a written price offer) first. Expect that it will need access to the store.
Close out unfulfilled orders (orders not yet shipped) on the old supplier before you connect it.
**Choose** the supplier that ships as fast or faster.

Choose a supplier with **reliable delivery** before you scale ad spend (grow how much money you spend on ads).
